g.text: Scope: cached reads, common packing/preparation, H2D, embeddings, all decoder layers and last-position logits; no decode or initial downloads.

g.text: Common preparation includes Strassen packing for every arm. Small differences from 3 passes are descriptive, not established deployment gains.
